title: Frequency-aware decomposition learning for sensorless wrench estimation in vibration-rich robotic contact
abstract: arXiv:2604.12905v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Force and torque (F/T) sensors enable contact-aware control by providing reactive feedback, but they are often fragile and expensive. To overcome these limitations, sensorless methods estimate F/T or wrench solely from robot proprioception, and have shown success in slow interaction tasks such as grasping. However, their low-pass characteristics limit the estimation of high-frequency signals, which are critical in rapid-contact tasks such as grinding. Communication delays can also make their estimates outdated during deployment, but few methods address this directly. translated_title: 面向振动丰富机器人接触场景的无传感器力旋量估计：频率感知分解学习方法
translated_abstract: 力/力矩（F/T）传感器通过提供反应式反馈实现接触感知控制，但其通常脆弱且昂贵。为克服这些局限，无传感器方法仅通过机器人本体感知来估计F/T或力旋量，并已在抓取等慢速交互任务中取得成功。然而，此类方法的低通特性限制了对高频信号的估计能力，而高频信号在研磨等快速接触任务中至关重要。此外，通信延迟会使估计值在部署时变得过时，但很少有方法直接解决这一问题。为弥补这些不足，我们提出了一种频率感知分解网络，以无传感器、多步预测的方式估计富含振动的力旋量。考虑到更高频率的随机性，FDN将力旋量预测序列在频谱上分解为低频趋势和高频残差两部分，分别通过逐点回归和学习的条件生成模型进行估计（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出频率感知分解网络（FDN），将力旋量频谱分解为低频趋势与高频残差分别估计，实现无传感器、多步预测的富含振动力旋量估计，突破了传统方法低通特性的限制并应对通信延迟问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes a Frequency-aware Decomposition Network (FDN) that spectrally decomposes the wrench into a low-frequency trend and a high-frequency residual, enabling sensorless, multi-step-ahead estimation of vibration-rich wrench while overcoming low-pass limitations and communication delays.
